content.title: KINTEX · Instagram × Threads Creator Day · Planning Report

sections.text: A review concept for an approximately 40 × 30m event area inside KINTEX Hall 1B. It does not fill the entire 171 × 63m hall. Layout, aisles and seating access stay exactly as-is. New feature walls and signature objects dress the existing partitions and open floor.

Connect Instagram visual creation and Threads public conversation in one visit. A bright production studio expresses creation; a calm salon supports reading and conversation. Feature walls carry large English lettering such as CREATOR CONNECTION DAY, Shoot. Edit. Post., and Share your take on Threads. This is a demo interpretation, not an official brand guide.

Registration → capture → editing feedback → conversations → rest remains the planned route. Photo queues and stage access stay separated, with signature photo moments placed clear of aisles, doors and seats. The central connector and circulation spines support the route. This is a plan, not a simulation; on-site verification is required.

The core program includes one welcome desk, three capture sets, two editing tables, four conversation tables, a talk stage with 24 audience chairs, a lounge and equipment storage. An extended salon adds two conversation tables, with display pods connecting salon and stage. Feature walls and four signature objects — welcome arch, phone centerpiece, truss ring with spots, and like-heart sculpture — are dressing only. Counts are design assumptions, not validated capacity.

Ceiling height is unconfirmed. Partitions are at most 3.2m high; truss arch and stage ring are tall floor-supported elements with no suspension proposed. Scale is estimated from dimension annotations. Entrances, columns and safety conditions remain unverified; accessible routes need on-site checks.
